chunks: Never have We destroyed a habitation till We had sent admonishers to them
ai.seo_question: Why did God destroy the cities of the prophets?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle of divine justice (Adl), affirming that God does not punish a people until they have received clear, undeniable proof through His messengers. It highlights the universal scope of prophethood, suggesting that every community had access to guidance, thereby removing any excuse for disbelief on the Day of Judgment.
